subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

YCG 87 IMQ 95 SWA 103 CGK 111 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6b463a56fbe1d551f3a85ad1dbdae0c8be5e6d6618afa35e4108ff6c32a9662.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The all the letter of each cluster is increased by 10 positions in the alphabetical series to get the first letter of the next cluster.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abfeae1b64a018d75f240cba27bf0f7ae546786f34aeb4ee29aa9d491121b10c.png] 

 

Therefore, the cluster that replaces the question mark is **MQU 119**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
